title: After 25+ years at Microsoft, I can tell you why Windows was neglected
excerpt: An ex-Microsoft employee of 25+ years explains why Windows was neglected, and why its new quality push echoes the Trustworthy Computing era.
content_html:
I wrote in the article I spent 25+ years at Microsoft, and Windows is getting the care it deserves again about how Windows evolved over the years, and that Microsoft said it’s putting more effort into it again; CEO Satya Nadella said it’s getting a new focus. From the comments, it’s clear that at least some readers don’t believe them.

Microsoft would not exist today if it hadn’t been for Windows, but it’s no surprise that the relative importance of such a core product has dimmed as other parts of the company grew.

Nobody buys Windows these days, for the most part. The spectacle of computer stores opening at midnight to sell Windows 95 to queues of expectant buyers hasn’t happened since. If you buy a new PC, it will likely come with Windows 11 pre-installed and inevitably the OEM will be paying some amount back to Microsoft to license the OS.

If you’re building your own PC from scratch, maybe you’d decide to shell out £120 (in the UK) for the Home edition, or £220 if you need some of the extra Pro goodness (assuming you’re not just going to use Linux; while that might be increasingly viable for techies, it’s a small percentage of the overall market). Maybe there are good numbers of people paying to upgrade up to Pro from the Home edition shipped with a new PC, but I bet the number of people buying a full, discrete license of Windows 11 is vanishingly small.

Traditionally, Microsoft made most of its Windows revenue from those OEMs selling it pre-installed on new PCs, or from enterprises who will license the Windows Pro/Enterprise desktop as part of a larger package. Many companies will have Microsoft 365 which includes Office apps and services, security suites and Windows client licenses, all built in. They might even buy Windows 365, meaning the whole thing is running in Microsoft’s datacenters, and they remotely access the machines.

“Which of your children do you love the most?”

In a large company like Microsoft (or Apple, Alphabet/Google, Amazon etc), investment in product and attention from executives tends to go on where they see growth opportunities and where they fear competitive threats. Throughout the company’s growth, the darling products will change – from Apple being the Mac company to the iPhone, Google Cloud becoming almost a fifth of the company, and Microsoft moving on from its Windows & Office duopoly to other areas. Some products or services will receive out-of-proportion investment because of the feeling of strategic importance – see all the $billions being poured into AI datacenters in the hope that there will be a payback in coming years.

Money that’s classed as R&D will be spent on current products, but is really just to improve current products with new features. Most technology companies will also have investment into research that one day may pay off, such as quantum computing.

Microsoft Research has a variety of long-term projects, pursuits that don’t actively develop a current product, but they’re there for the future. Technologies like fonts (remember ClearType?), handwriting and speech recognition have been developed in labs for decades but weren’t really about building a specific product. Measuring RoI on any kind of “pure research” is hard, as is the nearer term stuff that will just make things better.

Putting (say) an extra $1Bn into Windows development isn’t going to double its user base or meaningfully prevent existing users from replacing their PC with something else. Pouring money into Surface devices over the years might have helped Microsoft show the OEMs what they expect PCs to be like, and to try to compete with Apple doing arguably a better job on making more desirable Macbooks and the like.

Not putting $1Bn into fixing the broken windows and leaking roof of the old building that is Windows, could be more costly to Microsoft in the long run.

Windows’ wilderness years

Cartoonist and software engineer Manu Cornet published a joke Organization Chart which showed how different companies were structured…

Microsoft was famous for having warring factions competing against each other for investment and power. When Satya Nadella took over the reins at Microsoft, he even referenced this depiction in the opening pages of his book, “Hit Refresh”, and pledged to change the culture.

Everybody involved in developing a product wants it to be a good one – even if the Corporate Hunger Games mean that some groups get more influence than others. What I mean is that nobody is deliberately writing and releasing a bad product but if that does happen, it’s because of lack of attention, or infighting got in the way and maybe a few poor decisions were taken.

Windows client used to be the big dog, but its strategic importance to Microsoft as a whole has been waning for years. Even if a customer has a Mac on their desk and an iPhone in their hand, Microsoft will have something else in the ecosystem to sell them.

You won’t get anyone in Microsoft publicly admitting that they had neglected Windows in favour of something else altogether more shiny, but some mis-steps might have made that happen. A reorganization in 2018 split Windows into the core OS that sat in the Cloud & AI group (essentially Azure and all its friends, including Windows Server, under Scott Guthrie) and the UI and Apps belonging to the Experiences & Devices group, led by Rajesh Jha. Windows no longer reported to the CEO.

Panos Panay took charge in 2020, reuniting the Windows client teams and joining together with Surface hardware, launching Windows 11 the following year. The combo of OS and hardware all under one roof continued in the hands of Pavan Davuluri after Panos left for Amazon to head up their devices business. Initially, Pavan reported into Rajesh Jha, but since Rajesh announced his retirement in March 2026, Pavan has directly reported into Satya. So having split things apart and moved them around, Windows’ org has been rebuilt and it appears has been tasked with improving quality.

Perhaps there has been a realization that a bad product is in danger of having customers lose faith in the whole offering. If Windows has become, through lack of attention, a poor quality product that makes people unhappy, then if enough enterprises didn’t like what was going on with the desktop OS, they might be less keen on buying all the other stuff that’s sold to them as a follow on.

Learning from past mistakes

Take the furore around viruses and worms which blew up in the early 2000s: there was Code:Red, Nimda, ILOVEYOU and many more. Real reputational harm was being done to Microsoft because of the attacks on Windows, SQL, Office, and management was forced to act.

Microsoft halted all development and forced their developers to switch to undertaking training into writing secure code, then doing drains-up security reviews of existing code. Feature work was delayed unless it was building new capabilities to improve security: that’s where XP SP2 came from. This exercise was called the “Trustworthy Computing” (TwC) Initiative, with Bill Gates declaring, “When we face a choice between adding features and resolving security issues, we need to choose security.”

The recent mood music from Microsoft about fixing some of the issues with Windows 11 and making sure the quality bar for updates is higher, sounds like a similar move to TwC – the risk if they don’t do it, is to lose support from key customers. If Windows is the cornerstone for the rest of their Microsoft estate, they may move components away to competitors – identity, security, productivity – and eventually maybe even replace Windows with something else.

TwC was as much about being seen to do the right thing as it was about doing the right things. This supposed new focus on Windows quality feels like it could be in the same vein, and it’s about time.

A reorganization in 2018 split Windows into the core OS that sat in the Cloud & AI group (essentially Azure and all its friends, including Windows Server, under Scott Guthrie) and the UI and Apps belonging to the Experiences & Devices group, led by Rajesh Jha. Windows no longer reported to the CEO.

sentences.en: You won’t get anyone in Microsoft publicly admitting that they had neglected Windows in favour of something else altogether more shiny, but some mis-steps might have made that happen.
sentences.zh: 你不会让微软公司的任何人公开承认他们忽视了Windows而转而选择其他更闪亮的东西，但一些失误可能导致了这种情况的发生。

sentences.en: A reorganization in 2018 split Windows into the core OS that sat in the Cloud & AI group (essentially Azure and all its friends, including Windows Server, under Scott Guthrie) and the UI and Apps belonging to the Experiences & Devices group, led by Rajesh Jha.
sentences.zh: 2018 年的重组将 Windows 分为核心操作系统和属于体验与设备团队的 UI 和应用程序，核心操作系统属于云和人工智能小组（本质上是 Azure 及其所有朋友，包括 Scott Guthrie 领导下的 Windows Server），而 UI 和应用程序属于体验与设备小组，由 Rajesh Jha 领导。

sentences.en: Windows no longer reported to the CEO.
sentences.zh: Windows 不再向首席执行官汇报。

blocks.html_en: Panos Panay took charge in 2020, reuniting the Windows client teams and joining together with Surface hardware, launching Windows 11 the following year. The combo of OS and hardware all under one roof continued in the hands of Pavan Davuluri after Panos left for Amazon to head up their devices business. Initially, Pavan reported into Rajesh Jha, but since Rajesh announced his retirement in March 2026, Pavan has directly reported into Satya. So having split things apart and moved them around, Windows’ org has been rebuilt and it appears has been tasked with improving quality.

sentences.en: Panos Panay took charge in 2020, reuniting the Windows client teams and joining together with Surface hardware, launching Windows 11 the following year.
sentences.zh: Panos Panay 于 2020 年上任，重组了 Windows 客户端团队，并与 Surface 硬件联手，于次年推出了 Windows 11。

sentences.en: The combo of OS and hardware all under one roof continued in the hands of Pavan Davuluri after Panos left for Amazon to head up their devices business.
sentences.zh: 在帕诺斯前往亚马逊负责其设备业务后，操作系统和硬件的组合继续由 Pavan Davuluri 负责。

sentences.en: So having split things apart and moved them around, Windows’ org has been rebuilt and it appears has been tasked with improving quality.
sentences.zh: 因此，在将事物拆分并移动后，Windows 组织已经重建，并且似乎肩负着提高质量的任务。

blocks.html_en: Perhaps there has been a realization that a bad product is in danger of having customers lose faith in the whole offering. If Windows has become, through lack of attention, a poor quality product that makes people unhappy, then if enough enterprises didn’t like what was going on with the desktop OS, they might be less keen on buying all the other stuff that’s sold to them as a follow on.

sentences.zh: 也许人们已经认识到，劣质产品可能会导致客户对整个产品失去信心。

sentences.en: If Windows has become, through lack of attention, a poor quality product that makes people unhappy, then if enough enterprises didn’t like what was going on with the desktop OS, they might be less keen on buying all the other stuff that’s sold to them as a follow on.
sentences.zh: 如果Windows由于缺乏关注而成为一种质量低劣的产品，让人们不高兴，那么如果有足够多的企业不喜欢桌面操作系统的现状，他们可能就不太热衷于购买作为后续产品出售给他们的所有其他产品。

blocks.html_en: Learning from past mistakes

sentences.en: Learning from past mistakes
sentences.zh: 从过去的错误中吸取教训

blocks.html_en: Take the furore around viruses and worms which blew up in the early 2000s: there was Code:Red, Nimda, ILOVEYOU and many more. Real reputational harm was being done to Microsoft because of the attacks on Windows, SQL, Office, and management was forced to act.

sentences.en: Take the furore around viruses and worms which blew up in the early 2000s: there was Code:Red, Nimda, ILOVEYOU and many more.
sentences.zh: 以 2000 年代初爆发的病毒和蠕虫病毒为例：Code:Red、Nimda、ILOVEYOU 等等。

sentences.en: Real reputational harm was being done to Microsoft because of the attacks on Windows, SQL, Office, and management was forced to act.
sentences.zh: 由于针对 Windows、SQL、Office 的攻击，微软的声誉受到了真正的损害，管理层被迫采取行动。

blocks.html_en: Microsoft halted all development and forced their developers to switch to undertaking training into writing secure code, then doing drains-up security reviews of existing code. Feature work was delayed unless it was building new capabilities to improve security: that’s where XP SP2 came from. This exercise was called the “Trustworthy Computing” (TwC) Initiative, with Bill Gates declaring, “When we face a choice between adding features and resolving security issues, we need to choose security.”

sentences.en: Microsoft halted all development and forced their developers to switch to undertaking training into writing secure code, then doing drains-up security reviews of existing code.
sentences.zh: 微软停止了所有开发，并迫使他们的开发人员转而接受编写安全代码的培训，然后对现有代码进行大量的安全审查。

sentences.en: Feature work was delayed unless it was building new capabilities to improve security: that’s where XP SP2 came from.
sentences.zh: 除非构建新功能来提高安全性，否则功能工作就会被推迟：这就是 XP SP2 的由来。

sentences.en: This exercise was called the “Trustworthy Computing” (TwC) Initiative, with Bill Gates declaring, “When we face a choice between adding features and resolving security issues, we need to choose security.”
sentences.zh: 这项活动被称为“可信计算”（TwC）计划，比尔·盖茨宣称：“当我们面临添加功能和解决安全问题之间的选择时，我们需要选择安全性。”

blocks.html_en: The recent mood music from Microsoft about fixing some of the issues with Windows 11 and making sure the quality bar for updates is higher, sounds like a similar move to TwC – the risk if they don’t do it, is to lose support from key customers. If Windows is the cornerstone for the rest of their Microsoft estate, they may move components away to competitors – identity, security, productivity – and eventually maybe even replace Windows with something else.

sentences.en: The recent mood music from Microsoft about fixing some of the issues with Windows 11 and making sure the quality bar for updates is higher, sounds like a similar move to TwC – the risk if they don’t do it, is to lose support from key customers.
sentences.zh: 微软最近关于修复 Windows 11 的一些问题并确保更高的更新质量标准的情绪音乐，听起来像是与 TwC 类似的举措——如果他们不这样做，风险就是失去关键客户的支持。

sentences.en: If Windows is the cornerstone for the rest of their Microsoft estate, they may move components away to competitors – identity, security, productivity – and eventually maybe even replace Windows with something else.
sentences.zh: 如果 Windows 是微软其他业务的基石，他们可能会将组件（身份、安全、生产力）转移给竞争对手，最终甚至可能用其他东西取代 Windows。

blocks.html_en: TwC was as much about being seen to do the right thing as it was about doing the right things. This supposed new focus on Windows quality feels like it could be in the same vein, and it’s about time.

sentences.en: TwC was as much about being seen to do the right thing as it was about doing the right things.
sentences.zh: TwC 不仅在于做正确的事，还在于让人们看到自己在做正确的事。

sentences.en: This supposed new focus on Windows quality feels like it could be in the same vein, and it’s about time.
sentences.zh: 这种对 Windows 质量的新关注似乎也是出于同样的目的，而且是时候了。

content_html_zh:
我在《我在微软工作了 25 年多》的文章中写道，Windows 再次得到了它应有的关注，关于 Windows 多年来的演变，微软表示将再次投入更多的努力；首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella) 表示，公司正在寻找新的焦点。 从评论中可以明显看出，至少有一些读者不相信他们的说法。

如果没有 Windows，微软就不会存在于今天，但随着公司其他部门的发展，这种核心产品的相对重要性逐渐减弱也就不足为奇了。

如今，大多数情况下没有人购买 Windows。 此后，计算机商店半夜开门向排队等候的购买者出售 Windows 95 的景象再也没有发生过。 如果您购买一台新 PC，它可能会预装 Windows 11，并且 OEM 不可避免地会向 Microsoft 支付一定费用以获得操作系统许可。

如果您要从头开始构建自己的 PC，也许您会决定花费 120 英镑（在英国）购买家庭版，或者如果您需要一些额外的专业版功能，则需要花费 220 英镑（假设您不仅仅要使用 Linux；虽然这对于技术人员来说可能越来越可行，但它只占整个市场的一小部分）。 也许有很多人付费从新 PC 附带的家庭版升级到专业版，但我敢打赌，购买完整、独立的 Windows 11 许可证的人数微乎其微。

传统上，微软的大部分 Windows 收入来自那些在新 PC 上预装 Windows 的原始设备制造商 (OEM)，或者来自将 Windows 专业版/企业版桌面作为更大软件包的一部分进行许可的企业。 许多公司都会拥有 Microsoft 365，其中包括 Office 应用程序和服务、安全套件和 Windows 客户端许可证，全部都是内置的。 他们甚至可能购买 Windows 365，这意味着整个系统都在微软的数据中心运行，并且他们可以远程访问这些机器。

“你最喜欢你的哪个孩子？”

在像微软（或苹果、Alphabet/谷歌、亚马逊等）这样的大公司中，高管对产品的投资和注意力往往集中在他们看到增长机会和担心竞争威胁的地方。 在公司的发展过程中，最受欢迎的产品将会发生变化——从苹果公司的 Mac 到 iPhone，谷歌云几乎占公司的五分之一，而微软则从 Windows 和 Office 双头垄断转向其他领域。 一些产品或服务会因为战略重要性而获得不成比例的投资——看看所有数十亿美元都投入到人工智能数据中心，希望在未来几年能得到回报。

研发资金将用于当前产品，但实际上只是用新功能改进当前产品。 大多数科技公司还将投资于有朝一日可能获得回报的研究，例如量子计算。

微软研究院有各种长期项目和追求，这些项目并不积极开发当前产品，但它们是为了未来而存在的。 字体（还记得 ClearType 吗？）、手写和语音识别等技术已经在实验室中开发了数十年，但并不是真正用于构建特定产品。 衡量任何类型的“纯研究”的投资回报率都很困难，短期内只会让事情变得更好的东西也是如此。

额外投入（比如说）10 亿美元用于 Windows 开发并不会使其用户群增加一倍，也不会有效地阻止现有用户用其他设备替换他们的 PC。 多年来向 Surface 设备投入资金可能有助于微软向 OEM 展示他们对 PC 的期望，并试图与苹果竞争，在制造更受欢迎的 Macbook 等产品方面做得更好。

从长远来看，如果不投入 10 亿美元来修复 Windows 旧建筑的破损窗户和漏水屋顶，微软的成本可能会更高。

Windows 的荒野岁月

漫画家兼软件工程师 Manu Cornet 发布了一个笑话组织结构图，其中展示了不同公司的结构......

微软因交战派系相互争夺投资和权力而闻名。 当萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella) 接管微软时，他甚至在他的书《Hit Refresh》的开头几页中引用了这一描述，并承诺改变这种文化。

每个参与开发产品的人都希望它是一款好产品——即使“企业饥饿游戏”意味着某些群体比其他群体获得更大的影响力。 我的意思是，没有人故意编写和发布糟糕的产品，但如果确实发生这种情况，那是因为缺乏关注，或者是内讧阻碍了，也许是做出了一些糟糕的决定。

Windows客户端曾经是大狗，但它对整个微软的战略重要性多年来一直在减弱。 即使客户桌上有 Mac，手里有 iPhone，微软也会在生态系统中提供其他东西来销售他们。

你不会让微软公司的任何人公开承认他们忽视了Windows而转而选择其他更闪亮的东西，但一些失误可能导致了这种情况的发生。 2018 年的重组将 Windows 分为核心操作系统和属于体验与设备团队的 UI 和应用程序，核心操作系统属于云和人工智能小组（本质上是 Azure 及其所有朋友，包括 Scott Guthrie 领导下的 Windows Server），而 UI 和应用程序属于体验与设备小组，由 Rajesh Jha 领导。 Windows 不再向首席执行官汇报。

Panos Panay 于 2020 年上任，重组了 Windows 客户端团队，并与 Surface 硬件联手，于次年推出了 Windows 11。 在帕诺斯前往亚马逊负责其设备业务后，操作系统和硬件的组合继续由 Pavan Davuluri 负责。 最初，Pavan 向 Rajesh Jha 汇报，但自从 Rajesh Jha 于 2026 年 3 月宣布退休后，Pavan 直接向 Satya 汇报。 因此，在将事物拆分并移动后，Windows 组织已经重建，并且似乎肩负着提高质量的任务。

也许人们已经认识到，劣质产品可能会导致客户对整个产品失去信心。 如果Windows由于缺乏关注而成为一种质量低劣的产品，让人们不高兴，那么如果有足够多的企业不喜欢桌面操作系统的现状，他们可能就不太热衷于购买作为后续产品出售给他们的所有其他产品。

从过去的错误中吸取教训

以 2000 年代初爆发的病毒和蠕虫病毒为例：Code:Red、Nimda、ILOVEYOU 等等。 由于针对 Windows、SQL、Office 的攻击，微软的声誉受到了真正的损害，管理层被迫采取行动。

微软停止了所有开发，并迫使他们的开发人员转而接受编写安全代码的培训，然后对现有代码进行大量的安全审查。 除非构建新功能来提高安全性，否则功能工作就会被推迟：这就是 XP SP2 的由来。 这项活动被称为“可信计算”（TwC）计划，比尔·盖茨宣称：“当我们面临添加功能和解决安全问题之间的选择时，我们需要选择安全性。”

微软最近关于修复 Windows 11 的一些问题并确保更高的更新质量标准的情绪音乐，听起来像是与 TwC 类似的举措——如果他们不这样做，风险就是失去关键客户的支持。 如果 Windows 是微软其他业务的基石，他们可能会将组件（身份、安全、生产力）转移给竞争对手，最终甚至可能用其他东西取代 Windows。

TwC 不仅在于做正确的事，还在于让人们看到自己在做正确的事。 这种对 Windows 质量的新关注似乎也是出于同样的目的，而且是时候了。
